## `neuro.int16Array.sort`

Instance method on `Int16Array.prototype`.

> Sorts an array.

## Signatures

```ts
sort(input: { int16Array: <receiver>; compareFn?: (a: number; b: number) => number; prompt?: string }): Promise<Int16Array>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Int16Array.prototype.sort` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
